slides.title: List Comprehension Basics
slides.prompt: List comprehension provides a concise syntax for creating new lists based on existing iterables.
slides.codeSnippet:
squares = [x**2 for x in range(5)]
evens = [x for x in range(10) if x % 2 == 0]
